title: Even High School Boys Have Their Holes… / Ume Takes Responsibility
overview: Ume Mizunoe joins the student council so he doesn't have to repeat a year, but everyone there has such unique personalities. He nervously starts working there and gets thrown around by the council's strong personalities!

title: Savior Tan / The Seven Mysteries of the Academy and the Council’s Night Patrol / Komaro Is Here!
overview: Ume drops by the student council room as he takes care of something early in the morning. He then finds a young girl covered in blood slumped over a desk! And it seems the girl has become quite attached to Ume!?

title: Pool Cleaning and the Swimsuit Episode / I’m Happy for You
overview: When Ume gets home, he finds a suspicious figure—who turns out to be none other than his sister, Sho Mizunoe! Sho, Arisu, and Komaro engage in a who-knows-Ume-more one-upping battle. What's going on here!?

title: Komaro and Her Suggestion Box / Terui-senpai’s Secret / Koki-chan and the Light Music Club / Rendezvous in the Gym Storage Room!!
overview: The student council receives a complaint from the British tea ceremony club that the nearby music club is too noisy. It's not the instruments causing the noise, but something a bit more sensual!?

title: Preparing for the Student Council’s Bonding Retreat! / Operation Ume Tan-Tan! / Ume Shares His Umbrella
